approval_limit: Approval covers the interpretation in the exact hashed documents only. It does not validate generated forecasts, admit option-source modeling, authorize a repair of either failed attempt, or register or execute the proposed next verifier.

findings.finding: Wave16 is consistently UNEVALUABLE, with both comparisons p1, no lead and no accepted predictive evidence. The failure values are not described as statistical null results.

6297 forecast rows and 101 monthly fit records match the metadata-based failure audit. The 144810 generated sequence total includes those unverified rows; 138513 earlier generated rows plus 6297 equals 144810. The text does not promote the combined total as independently verified.

399 source files, 1684 current manifest entries, 1631 unique prior pins, 129 ledger events and 125 cumulative hypotheses agree with the failure audit. The earlier 125-event wave15 failure remains separately preserved.

The 99th baseline replay, 2025-08-01, 3055 training rows, 20 iterations and reported gradients/objective match the saved diagnosis. The 98 preceding accepted baseline checks are explicitly partial, not full forecast verification. Finite-precision stopping is a supported explanation, not a proven reconstruction of the exact unsaved trial step.

Analytic intercept profiling retains the actual sample-mean term and .01 slope penalty. The stated gradient and weighted-covariance Hessian are correct; Hessian>=.02I gives the stated slope-distance and objective-gap bounds in exact arithmetic. For unit descent direction v, R=2*(-g.v)/.02 makes the directional derivative positive at R under the curvature bound.

The original full-gradient, coefficient, normalized-prediction, source and scientific gates remain. Floating-point residual bounds are not called interval proofs. The new note recognizes that auxiliary weight underflow at a trial bracket endpoint can fail the proposed algorithm even when a valid optimum exists; feasibility must be established synthetically before registration. No algorithm implementation or historical rerun is approved by this publication review.

Summary accurately reflects the reviewed documentary note: quote width remains unadmitted; quarterly archive delivery, unresolved mirror permission and quote-clock semantics do not establish next-session availability or executable quotes. Existing private diagnostics are not treated as source authorization. This review did not independently refetch external sources.
All absolute local links in the four reviewed narrative documents resolve to existing files.
